lens: layout and typography; screenshot-only assessment of account sections. Accessibility scores cover visible presentation only. Crop edges are not treated as missing parent padding.

findings.issue: The Accounts heading has the same muted treatment as the loaded/eligible metadata; after also gives Weekly Remaining equal emphasis.
findings.fix: Give Accounts a slightly stronger weight or brighter text while retaining muted metadata and the existing font size.

findings.issue: Weekly quota remaining sits at the far right, visually associating the shared label with the third account.
findings.fix: Place the shared label beside Accounts, as the after screenshot does.

findings.observation: Account names, bold percentages and secondary warning values retain clear aligned rows. No score drops.

findings.issue: Accounts does not stand out from the adjacent section metadata.
findings.fix: Increase only the heading's weight or brightness; keep the compact single-line header.

findings.issue: The right-aligned weekly label appears attached to the last column rather than the group.
findings.fix: Use the after screenshot's placement beside Accounts.

findings.observation: The longer header still fits, and all three account names and percentage columns remain legible without visible collisions. No score drops.

findings.issue: The section title remains visually secondary to the account names and Expand All control.
findings.fix: Make Accounts semibold while keeping Weekly Remaining and the account counts muted.

findings.issue: Weekly quota remaining occupies a separate right-aligned line beneath the header controls, delaying the first account.
findings.fix: Combine it with the title line, as shown after.

findings.observation: The header is shorter, the account stack starts sooner, and warning labels and values fit cleanly. No score drops.

findings.issue: The muted Accounts heading provides little separation from the counts and weekly label.
findings.fix: Strengthen Accounts alone through weight or brightness.

findings.issue: The standalone weekly-label line adds another header level above an already tall account stack.
findings.fix: Keep the weekly label on the title line, as shown after.

findings.issue: Weekly quota unavailable appears larger than the account name and other warning text, giving this secondary status disproportionate emphasis.
findings.fix: Use the same compact text size as the 5-Hour Limit warning while retaining the amber colour and its separate line.

findings.observation: The long account name wraps without colliding with its percentage; the percentage remains aligned with the first name line. No score drops.

findings.issue: Accounts has the same visual emphasis as the loaded/eligible counts.
findings.fix: Make Accounts slightly brighter or heavier without enlarging the header.

findings.issue: The shared weekly label sits above the unavailable third account, making its scope visually uneven.
findings.fix: Place the label beside the section title, as shown after.

findings.observation: The unavailable account retains the same name/value alignment as the loaded accounts, with an explicit status below and a dash in the value position. No score drops.

findings.issue: The section heading blends into the adjacent metadata.
findings.fix: Give Accounts a stronger weight or brightness while leaving counts and the weekly descriptor muted.

findings.issue: Claude account 3 sits lower than the other account names because its percentage and Stale label occupy a taller right-hand block.
findings.fix: Top-align the account name with the percentage and place Stale beneath the percentage, as shown after.

findings.issue: The shared weekly descriptor is detached at the far right.
findings.fix: Move it beside Accounts, as shown after.

findings.observation: All account headings now align; Stale remains associated with its percentage and the timestamp remains readable below. No score drops.

findings.issue: Accounts is no more prominent than the section metadata despite introducing a dense set of metrics.
findings.fix: Strengthen the heading's weight or brightness without increasing its size.

findings.issue: 7-Day Opus occupies a lower row in the first account because Cloud Session Credits precedes it; horizontally scanning that row compares different metrics.
findings.fix: Place the shared 7-Day Opus metric before the account-specific Cloud Session Credits row, preserving the aligned footer divider.

findings.issue: Weekly quota remaining is isolated above the far-right account.
findings.fix: Use the after screenshot's shared label beside Accounts.

findings.observation: Bold summary percentages, right-aligned metric values, subdued bars and amber warnings maintain a compact, readable dark presentation. The header improvement does not resolve the metric-row mismatch, so layout remains 8. No score drops.
